directories.method: A listing is counted in a category only when the listing's OWN title, snippet or URL places it there. The search term that surfaced it is never treated as evidence about it — the same rule the web-discovery collector uses.
directories.access_method: Read through Google's/Bing's public index via SearXNG using site: queries. Five of the seven directories return HTTP 403 to a direct fetch, but their robots.txt files permit product and category pages — it is a WAF, not a policy. No bot protection was circumvented.

method: Keyword-driven web discovery. Every entrant is a fetched homepage; name and description come from that page's own metadata. Listicles and articles are excluded, as are the 7 tracked products and 92 known incumbents. Classification and threat score are derived ONLY from what each product publishes about itself — never from the keyword that surfaced it — and every signal records the phrase it matched.

delivery.reason: Email delivery is NOT configured. Add SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SMTP_FROM (or SMTP_USER), DIGEST_TO to .env. For Microsoft 365 use SMTP_HOST=smtp.office365.com SMTP_PORT=587 with an account that has SMTP AUTH enabled; for Google Workspace use smtp.gmail.com:587 with an App Password. Until then each digest is generated and stored under data/digests/ but not delivered.
